committees.name: Website and Digital
committees.responsibilities: Responsible for developing and maintaining the RuralConnect 2026 event website, designing posters and digital/physical banners, speaker-specific posters, invitation letters, integrating registration forms, managing online promotional materials, publishing approved program updates, supporting event-day digital communication, and showcasing competition results and event highlights.

committees.name: Venue and Logistics
committees.responsibilities: Responsible for venue booking and setup, decoration, bouquet, seating arrangements, stage and branding installation, audio-visual infrastructure, Wi-Fi and electrical facilities, ideathon workspaces, technical support, and smooth on-ground operations during RuralConnect 2026.

committees.name: Guest and Student Hospitality
committees.responsibilities: Responsible for invited guest reception and protocol, accommodation and transportation coordination, student assistance, welcome arrangements, and ensuring a comfortable experience for all participants during RuralConnect 2026.

committees.name: Ideathon
committees.responsibilities: Responsible for designing the ideathon challenges and rules, screening applications, shortlisting 20 teams, coordinating mentoring and jury evaluation, on-the-spot event organization, determining winners, and documenting competition outcomes.

committees.name: Food
committees.responsibilities: Responsible for menu planning, catering vendor coordination, food and refreshment arrangements, drinking water, meal-count management, food distribution, hygiene, quality control, and catering within the budget throughout RuralConnect 2026.

committees.name: Speakers, Tutorials and Program
committees.responsibilities: Responsible for identifying and confirming invited speakers, organizing AI-IoT and communication technology tutorial talks, preparing the complete two-day program, assigning session chairs and moderators, coordinating speaker presentations, and ensuring smooth and timely execution of all technical sessions during RuralConnect 2026.

committees.name: Event Registration Management
committees.responsibilities: Responsible for managing ideathon and workshop registrations, on-site registrations, maintaining participant databases, coordinating shortlisted-team confirmations, handling participant communication, organizing on-site registration and attendance, preparing verified certificate records, and ensuring smooth registration operations throughout RuralConnect 2026.

committees.name: Award, Jury and Documentation
committees.responsibilities: Responsible for jury coordination and scoring administration, result compilation, prizes and certificates, award ceremony management, and preparation of the final RuralConnect 2026 event report for institutional and IEEE ComSoc requirements.

committees.name: Photography and Videography
committees.responsibilities: Responsible for capturing high-quality photographs and videos of all event activities, managing live streaming of key sessions on YouTube, recording lectures and tutorials, and organizing audiovisual content for post-event highlights and archival documentation.
